purpose: Independent public Demo source capture and integrity evidence; no strategy, order or fill authority
targets: Exact current maker sampling window; 1-8 unique validated symbols, no new market selection
restart: Fresh epoch and subscription snapshots; never inherit sequence/book state across connections
capacity: Stop and retain all evidence; no automatic reset, deletion, shard rotation or cap extension
source_fault: Seal epoch; preserve valid prefix; sanitized error class only; reconnect after fixed delay
credentials: Existing Demo key only to exact literal Demo host; redirects forbidden; credentials never archived
integration: Separate bounded background thread in existing combined Demo worker; independent SQLite connection; no broker calls; no REST fallback for frozen decisions
readiness: Both subscription acknowledgements and valid snapshots required; public trades and source overlap are not owned fills
acceptance: Synthetic lifecycle/timeout/gap/cap/restart tests; genuine deployed accepted revision, source records and independent archive audit. No full trading qualification from this receipt.
